verses.ar: «لَا تَضْطَرِبْ قُلُوبُكُمْ. أَنْتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللهِ فَآمِنُوا بِي.
verses.kjv: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
verses.web: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.

verses.ar: فِي بَيْتِ أَبِي مَنَازِلُ كَثِيرَةٌ، وَإِلَّا فَإِنِّي كُنْتُ قَدْ قُلْتُ لَكُمْ. أَنَا أَمْضِي لِأُعِدَّ لَكُمْ مَكَانًا،
verses.kjv: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if [it were] not [so], I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
verses.web: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.

verses.ar: وَإِنْ مَضَيْتُ وَأَعْدَدْتُ لَكُمْ مَكَانًا آتِي أَيْضًا وَآخُذُكُمْ إِلَيَّ، حَتَّى حَيْثُ أَكُونُ أَنَا تَكُونُونَ أَنْتُمْ أَيْضًا،
verses.kjv: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, [there] ye may be also.
verses.web: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.

verses.ar: وَتَعْلَمُونَ حَيْثُ أَنَا أَذْهَبُ وَتَعْلَمُونَ ٱلطَّرِيقَ».
verses.kjv: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.
verses.web: You know where I go, and you know the way.”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهُ تُومَا: «يَا سَيِّدُ، لَسْنَا نَعْلَمُ أَيْنَ تَذْهَبُ، فَكَيْفَ نَقْدِرُ أَنْ نَعْرِفَ ٱلطَّرِيقَ؟».
verses.kjv: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
verses.web: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهُ يَسُوعُ: «أَنَا هُوَ ٱلطَّرِيقُ وَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَيَاةُ. لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ يَأْتِي إِلَى ٱلْآبِ إِلَّا بِي.
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
verses.web: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

verses.ar: لَوْ كُنْتُمْ قَدْ عَرَفْتُمُونِي لَعَرَفْتُمْ أَبِي أَيْضًا. وَمِنَ ٱلْآنَ تَعْرِفُونَهُ وَقَدْ رَأَيْتُمُوهُ».
verses.kjv: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
verses.web: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him and have seen him.”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهُ فِيلُبُّسُ: «يَا سَيِّدُ، أَرِنَا ٱلْآبَ وَكَفَانَا».
verses.kjv: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
verses.web: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهُ يَسُوعُ: «أَنَا مَعَكُمْ زَمَانًا هَذِهِ مُدَّتُهُ وَلَمْ تَعْرِفْنِي يَا فِيلُبُّسُ! اَلَّذِي رَآنِي فَقَدْ رَأَى ٱلْآبَ، فَكَيْفَ تَقُولُ أَنْتَ: أَرِنَا ٱلْآبَ؟
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou [then], Shew us the Father?
verses.web: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?

verses.ar: أَلَسْتَ تُؤْمِنُ أَنِّي أَنَا فِي ٱلْآبِ وَٱلْآبَ فِيَّ؟ ٱلْكَلَامُ ٱلَّذِي أُكَلِّمُكُمْ بِهِ لَسْتُ أَتَكَلَّمُ بِهِ مِنْ نَفْسِي، لَكِنَّ ٱلْآبَ ٱلْحَالَّ فِيَّ هُوَ يَعْمَلُ ٱلْأَعْمَالَ.
verses.kjv: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.
verses.web: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.

verses.ar: صَدِّقُونِي أَنِّي فِي ٱلْآبِ وَٱلْآبَ فِيَّ، وَإِلَّا فَصَدِّقُونِي لِسَبَبِ ٱلْأَعْمَالِ نَفْسِهَا.
verses.kjv: Believe me that I [am] in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
verses.web: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

verses.ar: اَلْحَقَّ ٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ: مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِي فَٱلْأَعْمَالُ ٱلَّتِي أَنَا أَعْمَلُهَا يَعْمَلُهَا هُوَ أَيْضًا، وَيَعْمَلُ أَعْظَمَ مِنْهَا، لِأَنِّي مَاضٍ إِلَى أَبِي.
verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater [works] than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
verses.web: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.

verses.ar: وَمَهْمَا سَأَلْتُمْ بِٱسْمِي فَذَلِكَ أَفْعَلُهُ لِيَتَمَجَّدَ ٱلْآبُ بِٱلِٱبْنِ.
verses.kjv: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
verses.web: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

verses.ar: إِنْ سَأَلْتُمْ شَيْئًا بِٱسْمِي فَإِنِّي أَفْعَلُهُ.
verses.kjv: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do [it.]
verses.web: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.

verses.ar: «إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُحِبُّونَنِي فَٱحْفَظُوا وَصَايَايَ،
verses.kjv: ¶ If ye love me, keep my commandments.
verses.web: If you love me, keep my commandments.

verses.ar: وَأَنَا أَطْلُبُ مِنَ ٱلْآبِ فَيُعْطِيكُمْ مُعَزِّيًا آخَرَ لِيَمْكُثَ مَعَكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ،
verses.kjv: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
verses.web: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:

verses.ar: رُوحُ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِي لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ ٱلْعَالَمُ أَنْ يَقْبَلَهُ، لِأَنَّهُ لَا يَرَاهُ وَلَا يَعْرِفُهُ، وَأَمَّا أَنْتُمْ فَتَعْرِفُونَهُ لِأَنَّهُ مَاكِثٌ مَعَكُمْ وَيَكُونُ فِيكُمْ.
verses.kjv: [Even] the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
verses.web: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.

verses.ar: لَا أَتْرُكُكُمْ يَتَامَى. إِنِّي آتِي إِلَيْكُمْ.
verses.kjv: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
verses.web: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

verses.ar: بَعْدَ قَلِيلٍ لَا يَرَانِي ٱلْعَالَمُ أَيْضًا، وَأَمَّا أَنْتُمْ فَتَرَوْنَنِي. إِنِّي أَنَا حَيٌّ فَأَنْتُمْ سَتَحْيَوْنَ.
verses.kjv: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.
verses.web: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.

verses.ar: فِي ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ تَعْلَمُونَ أَنِّي أَنَا فِي أَبِي، وَأَنْتُمْ فِيَّ، وَأَنَا فِيكُمْ.
verses.kjv: At that day ye shall know that I [am] in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.
verses.web: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

verses.ar: اَلَّذِي عِنْدَهُ وَصَايَايَ وَيَحْفَظُهَا فَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُحِبُّنِي، وَٱلَّذِي يُحِبُّنِي يُحِبُّهُ أَبِي، وَأَنَا أُحِبُّهُ، وَأُظْهِرُ لَهُ ذَاتِي».
verses.kjv: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
verses.web: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهُ يَهُوذَا لَيْسَ ٱلْإِسْخَرْيُوطِيَّ: «يَا سَيِّدُ، مَاذَا حَدَثَ حَتَّى إِنَّكَ مُزْمِعٌ أَنْ تُظْهِرَ ذَاتَكَ لَنَا وَلَيْسَ لِلْعَالَمِ؟».
verses.kjv: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
verses.web: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”

verses.ar: أَجَابَ يَسُوعُ وَقَالَ لَهُ: «إِنْ أَحَبَّنِي أَحَدٌ يَحْفَظْ كَلَامِي، وَيُحِبُّهُ أَبِي، وَإِلَيْهِ نَأْتِي، وَعِنْدَهُ نَصْنَعُ مَنْزِلًا.
verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
verses.web: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.

verses.ar: اَلَّذِي لَا يُحِبُّنِي لَا يَحْفَظُ كَلَامِي. وَٱلْكَلَامُ ٱلَّذِي تَسْمَعُونَهُ لَيْسَ لِي بَلْ لِلْآبِ ٱلَّذِي أَرْسَلَنِي.
verses.kjv: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father’s which sent me.
verses.web: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.

verses.ar: بِهَذَا كَلَّمْتُكُمْ وَأَنَا عِنْدَكُمْ.
verses.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, being [yet] present with you.
verses.web: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْمُعَزِّي، ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْقُدُسُ، ٱلَّذِي سَيُرْسِلُهُ ٱلْآبُ بِٱسْمِي، فَهُوَ يُعَلِّمُكُمْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ، وَيُذَكِّرُكُمْ بِكُلِّ مَا قُلْتُهُ لَكُمْ.
verses.kjv: But the Comforter, [which is] the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
verses.web: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.

verses.ar: «سَلَامًا أَتْرُكُ لَكُمْ. سَلَامِي أُعْطِيكُمْ. لَيْسَ كَمَا يُعْطِي ٱلْعَالَمُ أُعْطِيكُمْ أَنَا. لَا تَضْطَرِبْ قُلُوبُكُمْ وَلَا تَرْهَبْ.
verses.kjv: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
verses.web: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

verses.ar: سَمِعْتُمْ أَنِّي قُلْتُ لَكُمْ: أَنَا أَذْهَبُ ثُمَّ آتِي إِلَيْكُمْ. لَوْ كُنْتُمْ تُحِبُّونَنِي لَكُنْتُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ لِأَنِّي قُلْتُ أَمْضِي إِلَى ٱلْآبِ، لِأَنَّ أَبِي أَعْظَمُ مِنِّي.
verses.kjv: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come [again] unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
verses.web: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.

verses.ar: وَقُلْتُ لَكُمُ ٱلْآنَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَكُونَ، حَتَّى مَتَى كَانَ تُؤْمِنُونَ.
verses.kjv: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.
verses.web: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.

verses.ar: لَا أَتَكَلَّمُ أَيْضًا مَعَكُمْ كَثِيرًا، لِأَنَّ رَئِيسَ هَذَا ٱلْعَالَمِ يَأْتِي وَلَيْسَ لَهُ فِيَّ شَيْءٌ.
verses.kjv: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.
verses.web: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.

verses.ar: وَلَكِنْ لِيَفْهَمَ ٱلْعَالَمُ أَنِّي أُحِبُّ ٱلْآبَ، وَكَمَا أَوْصَانِي ٱلْآبُ هَكَذَا أَفْعَلُ. قُومُوا نَنْطَلِقْ مِنْ هَهُنَا.
verses.kjv: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
verses.web: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.
